rationale: Safe-harbor regions were identified computationally from epigenomic and transcriptomic properties rather than by targeted transgene integration.
The study provides orthogonal genomic context but does not experimentally validate individual candidate loci by SSI.
No targeted integration phenotype exists from which to derive a positive or negative locus label.
benchmark_observations.tsv is reserved for experimental integration observations; genome-wide omics-derived candidate intervals are not inserted as pseudo-observations.
Predicted permissive regions are not promoted to harmonized experimental loci.
Prediction-only evidence cannot enter the binary Gold benchmark.
The published Hi-C stable-region BED can later be used as an annotation/feature layer when characterizing experimentally validated loci, without circularly defining their labels.
